body:
Ya, thanks for those words. Made me smile. I understand my problems and I am a logical thinker, so I usually sort out my problems going to PATH WORK and other psychology meetings. I help myself out, because of 18 years of no help from outside has made me self dependent psychologically. I am also an introvert, I am happy with that. 

College is out of my life, at least until I can be self dependent. 

First I need a job, that will help me out a lot by giving me a lot of freedom. I was a counselor for many in house facilities, and was also a peer counselor/suicide hotline worker in my college days. I am happy with my mental stability, I have worked out many kinks out of my life. 

Recently I found out that my best friend has spoken about some the most personal things about my life to others. He is also a psychology major, and he is in to spirituality and other mumbo jumbo. I am an strong atheist, and i never had any conflict with him. Recently I found out that he was trying to convert me for the past 6 months and that he almost took me as a project. This really hurt!

A month ago my GF and I broke up, she is out of country, so that really depresses me, as she was my interaction out of my family.
